answer: Implemented FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task for the aeration blower delayed start. It uses a TON (PT = T#5S) gated by permit = DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC, forces BLOWER_RUN off and resets the timer whenever permit is FALSE, and increments AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT only on a FALSE→TRUE transition of BLOWER_RUN (tracked via bRunPrev). Outputs default to OFF/0 at power-up. The source compiled successfully in CODESYS 3.5 (0 errors, 0 warnings). Note: traces were validated only by inspection; no PLC functional tests were executed.
